Today, for the very first time on this channel, we will be talking about an engine coming from China. A mass-produced gasoline engine developed and built in China by automotive giant Geely. This engine achieves an incredible thermal efficiency of 48.41%. Of course, with this efficiency, it’s not surprising that this engine also powers the current Guinness World Record holder for the most fuel-efficient mass-produced hybrid (non-plug-in) vehicle.

Allow me to put the thermal efficiency into perspective: the best Toyota has achieved in their latest generation of dynamicforce engines is 41%. Nissan achieved 42% in their e-power system, where the engine only ever acts as a generator.
